descriptionHtml:
The following list shows what HDMI 2.1 can handle using its native 48Gbps bandwidth without relying on Display Stream Compression (DSC):

  • 1080p (Full HD):

    • 60Hz / 120Hz / 144Hz / 240Hz

  • 1440p (QHD):

    • 60Hz / 120Hz / 144Hz / 240Hz

  • 4K (Ultra HD):

    • 60Hz

    • 120Hz

    • 144Hz (This is the upper limit for uncompressed 4K at 10-bit color)

  • 5K:

    • 60Hz

  • 8K:

    • 30Hz

    • 60Hz (Requires 4:2:0 chroma)

Technical Specifications

  • Model/Version: HDMI Version 2.1V

  • Cable Type: Ultra High-Speed HDMI with Ethernet

  • Length: 1.5 Meters

  • Performance: High Performance Advanced Digital Audio/Video Cable
